channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: CM Revanth Reddy Urges Maoist Leaders Including Ganapati to Surrender as 130 Naxals Lay Down Arms
item.description: CM Revanth Reddy appeals to Maoist leaders including Ganapati to surrender as 130 Maoists lay down arms with 124 weapons at ICCC Hyderabad.

item.title: GHMC Intensifies Sanitation Drive in Hyderabad Under 99-Day “Praja Palana – Pragathi Pranalika” Programme
item.description: GHMC intensifies sanitation drive in Hyderabad under the 99-day Praja Palana – Pragathi Pranalika programme with inspections in Jubilee Hills and Banjara Hills.

item.title: GHMC WhatsApp Number to Report Sanitation Issues in Hyderabad Makes Complaints Easy
item.description: GHMC introduces WhatsApp number 8125966586 for citizens to report sanitation issues in Hyderabad including garbage, clogged nalas and green waste removal.

item.title: Viral Train Stunt for Social Media Likes Sparks Warning: Don’t Risk Life for Reels: Video
item.description: Viral train stunt for social media likes sparks warning as youths risk their lives performing dangerous stunts on moving trains for reels and online fame.

item.title: Middle East tensions to shape Indian stock market sentiments this week
item.description: Kuwait announced stopping oil production and refining output as tankers cannot transit the Persian Gulf due to threats from Iran. The Arab monarchy described the output reduction as a precautionary step, though it did not reveal the extent of the cut.

item.title: One killed, several injured as Class 9 student attacks hostel inmates in Karnataka’s Ballari
item.description: According to police, the accused student allegedly assaulted fellow hostel inmates with an iron rod following a minor dispute. The attack reportedly took place after dinner when the students were asleep in the hostel.

item.title: Andhra Governor, CMs of Telugu states greet women on International Women’s Day
item.description: "Women in our country have always played a great role in our freedom movement and upholding national integrity, peace and harmony. The International Women's Day is celebrated to highlight women’s achievements in society, politics, and the world economy and to raise awareness about their right to equality, justice and dignity.

item.title: West Asia conflict: UAE advises citizens against filming incident sites, prohibited areas
item.description: The authorities in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) have issued a warning that strict action will be taken against anyone who films incident sites, prohibited areas, or airport interiors without authorisation, the Embassy of India in Abu Dhabi said on Sunday.

item.title: Iran strikes Israeli refinery after attacks on Iranian energy infrastructure
item.description: Meanwhile, the National Iranian Oil Refining and Distribution Company said energy infrastructure in the country came under the US-Israeli attacks Saturday night, Xinhua news agency reported.

item.title: Pawan Kalyan expresses deep concern over President Murmu’s ‘painful’ remarks
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan said on Sunday that he was "deeply concerned by the painful and sad remarks" of President Droupadi Murmu regarding the conduct of the International Santal Conference in Darjeeling, West Bengal.
